$comment: The knowledge base the assistant answers from. ONLY official pages from the World Health Organization (who.int) and NAFDAC (nafdac.gov.ng), the fetcher and the ingester both refuse any other host. `npm run kb:fetch` downloads each page into kb/documents/<id>.md (with its URL, retrieval date and a content hash); review the diff, then `npm run kb:ingest`.
